title: Deny Container-Killing lsof/kill Shell Commands
description: When invoking commands like `kill $(lsof -t -i:9876)` (any port), the devcontainer is killed and all running work stops. Update agent hooks to deny this pattern (and equivalent variants) and return a meaningful reason, suggesting safer alternatives.
summary: Blocked container-killing terminal commands like `kill $(lsof -t -i:PORT)` in agent shell hooks via `IsToolBlocked`/`isCommandSegmentBlocked`, with a clear denial reason. Added regression tests and fixed repo/cli build by restoring missing `EditorHookMapping` alias + `EditorProvider` interface methods.
